animation.name: Armature|Take 001|BaseLayer
animation.semanticAssessment: Likely rig/control demonstration; inferred from asymmetric isolated joint activity and actual inspected poses. Not a validated idle or attack.
animation.recommendedRuntimeBehavior: Keep original sprite candidate for battle until purpose-authored clips and stance are reviewed.

skin.methodLimit: Nine sampled frames, fixed nearest-source initial-pose correspondence; coincident source vertices may be ambiguous.

defects: Single animation behaves like a rig control demonstration, not production battle motion.
Frame 51 neck/throat strongly stretches and compresses.
Initial pose is a stiff arms-out stance.
Glossy skin and coarse scale texture undermine realism.
Tail tip is solid orange textured geometry without emissive or animated flame treatment.
Eyes read dark and lack convincing depth.
Four-weight export introduces measurable localized skin error.
